messages:
Ava CS: Quick sync — preview cohort 'Pulse' enrollment finalized. Need to confirm seat allocation, schedule the enablement workshop, and set up the early feedback loop. Key customers: StellarPay (high usage, potential renewal risk), Finch Labs, Arbor Health. Who can own seat ops + workshop scheduling?

Ravi AE: I can own seat allocations for StellarPay + Finch. Do we have the contracted seat counts in a spreadsheet I can use?

Jordan Eng: Noted. Also StellarPay hit webhook 500s last week — they’ll need the integration snippet and a small retry guidance we can share. I’ll draft a minimal doc.

Priya PM: I’ll own the feedback template and dashboard. Proposing weekly 3-question pulse + one 1:1 at week 3. Also recommend success metrics: activation %, avg latency, error rate.

Diego Support: Filing INC-5234 for StellarPay webhook errors. Quick workaround: bump client timeout to 10s. Root cause looks like a retry storm from their proxy. I’ll post updates here.

Ava CS: Action items: \u2022 Ravi: claim seat ops + send enrollment CSV \u2022 Diego: own webhook fix + status \u2022 Jordan: publish integration snippet + sample cURL \u2022 Priya: set up survey + dashboard widgets \u2022 Ava: schedule enablement workshop (target next Tue 11:00 AM PT). @Ravi please confirm StellarPay seat count by EOD. @Jordan can you drop the snippet in #docs when ready?

Ravi AE: Confirmed counts: StellarPay 12 seats, Finch Labs 4 seats, Arbor Health 6 seats. Sending updated enrollment CSV to the cohort drive now.

Jordan Eng: Posted short integration note in #docs (https://redwood.docs/pulse/integrations). Snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/events \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"event":"chat_completion","payload":{"user_id":"123"}}'
```
Also added a note about honoring Retry-After and idempotency keys.

Priya PM: Draft survey uploaded: 3 pulse q's + NPS + optional screenshot upload. Hooking responses into a dashboard and tagging by cohort 'pulse-jan'. Will share the form link tomorrow.

Diego Support: Patch deployed to staging; StellarPay webhook now returns 200s in our tests. Monitoring for the next 24h and will escalate if we see regressions.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Pulse cohort enablement" on Tue at 11:00 AM PT. Attendees: Ava CS, Ravi AE, Jordan Eng, Priya PM, StellarPay-success@redwood.com

Ava CS: Perfect — one more ask: mark StellarPay as "at-risk" if activation < 40% by day 14. Priya, include that threshold on the dashboard and enable daily digests for the first week. Ravi, please prioritize StellarPay enablement invites for their admins.

Ravi AE: On it, sending invites now and will follow up with pre-kickoff checklist items.

Priya PM: Dashboard link (shared): https://dash.redwood.ai/shared/pulse-cohort — added activation and error-rate widgets.

Ava CS: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Friday EOD for a quick pulse. :thumbsup:
